messages: You're the cutest person ever, did you know that?
Today is ALL about you — enjoy every second!
Don't forget to smile, it looks amazing on you.
You make my world so much brighter just by being you.
I hope today feels as magical as you are.
You deserve every good thing coming your way.
Sending you the biggest hug through the screen right now.
21 years of pure awesomeness — the world is lucky to have you.
You light up every room you walk into.
I am so incredibly proud of you.
